tree.domainSub: A locally managed, multi-root folder tree
tree.projectionNotice: Projection files disappear when the email is deleted, and exclude inline images in the body; to keep one, use “Save to Library.”
tree.readonlyRoot: This is an index projection — it isn't on disk and can't be written to.
tree.mountUnavailable: This folder is unavailable (the external volume was unplugged or moved). The index is kept, but files can't be read right now.

menu.unmountHint: Nothing on disk is touched. Existing references gray out instead of breaking, and remounting the same folder picks up the same files

folder.sortDisabledHint: Sorting for this folder is fixed on the server for now
folder.tooLargeToast: “{name}” is over {limit} and was not saved
folder.uploadFailedToast: Could not save “{name}” to the library

empty.folderTitle: No files in this folder yet
empty.folderHint: Drop files in, or use “New markdown” in the top right.

history.externalNoNote: Changed outside the app, no note
history.empty: No history for this file yet
history.retention: Keeps the latest {n} snapshots per file; {size} across the library, oldest trimmed first
history.currentVersionHint: This snapshot matches the file on disk — nothing to roll back to
history.rollbackConfirmBody: Rolling back writes this snapshot's content again (same version check, and it records a new history entry). The current content is not lost.
history.rollbackDoneToast: Rolled back to the selected version
history.conflictTitle: The file changed — nothing was rolled back
history.conflictBody: It was edited outside the app after you opened this panel. The current version has been reloaded — you can roll back again.

preview.parsedHint: This is the parsed markdown, used for preview, search, and agent reading. Open the original with its matching app to see it as-is.
preview.pdfParsedHint: The PDF parsed version is plain text with page breaks (anydoc's PDF lane is off by default).
preview.originalUnavailable: The original can't be read on this machine right now — only the parsed view is available.
preview.htmlNotice: Rendered like a normal web page — scripts and styles run as-is, isolated from the app itself.
preview.noInline: This file type can't be previewed in the app.
preview.unsupported: Parsing isn't supported for this type yet
preview.fileStatusMissing: File is no longer on disk
preview.fileStatusMissingHint: The reference is kept — links in matters or chats won't dangle. Put the file back to restore it.
preview.conflictBody: Someone changed this file after you opened it. Below is the current version; your text is still in the edit box.
preview.noContent: This file has no text to show
preview.truncated: Long file — only the beginning is shown
preview.stale: The parsed text is older than the file; re-parsing
preview.failedHint: Could not get any text out of this file
preview.placeholderNotice: This is an iCloud placeholder — the content is not on this Mac yet
preview.imageTooLarge: Image is too large to show inline
preview.pdfOriginalPlaceholder: Inline preview of the original is not built yet — open it in your PDF reader

mount.pickHint: Pick a local folder to mount into the library. Files stay where they are — we only build an index.
mount.label: Display name
mount.roHint: Both you and agents can view but not change these files. You can switch to writable anytime.
mount.rwHint: You can edit these files; in chat, agents can too when their capability card is set to the write tier (same default as Agent docs). Unattended runs always treat mounted folders as read-only.
mount.estimate: Estimated {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
mount.tooMany: Estimated {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, over the 20,000-file limit. Choose a smaller subfolder.
mount.absPathNote: The absolute path is shown only here. Everywhere else in the app, and to agents, this folder appears as a virtual @label path.

settings.title: Library
settings.rescanHint: On-demand reconciliation: checks disk against the index and records external changes. There's no file watcher.
settings.chatArchiveTitle: Chat attachments are saved to the library
settings.chatArchiveHint: Written to a chat-attachments/year-month/ folder on send; deleting the chat doesn't delete these files.
settings.semanticNotReady: Currently keyword-only search (FTS5). Download the model or connect local Ollama to enable hybrid search.
settings.downloadCancelled: Download paused — partial file kept so you can resume anytime.
settings.noLocalServers: No running Ollama (11434) or LM Studio (1234) detected

search.emptyHint: Try a shorter query, or part of the filename.
search.noSemantic: Semantic search isn't on (model not downloaded) — matching by keyword only.
search.warnGeneric: One part of this search didn't run.

agent.conflictRetryNote: The file changed — the tool will re-read the current version and try again.

chip.notArchivedHint: Archiving failed (backend not running or disk full) — only the extracted text was sent to the model this time.
chip.composerNotice: Chat attachments are saved to the library

picker.title: Choose from Library
picker.keepDesc: Pick a folder to save this attachment into. Once saved, it no longer depends on the email.
picker.moveDesc: Pick a new location. References to this file still work, but paths written down elsewhere will change.
picker.exportDesc: Pick a folder to save this report into as Markdown.
picker.pickHint: The files you pick are sent as attachments; the originals stay in the Library.

matter.searchPrompt: Type a keyword to find files in your library

deeplink.missingToast: This file is no longer in the library
deeplink.trashedToast: This file is in Trash — opened Trash for you

trash.notice: Deleted files stay in Trash for 30 days, then are cleared automatically.
trash.deleteConfirmBodyMount: Deletions in mounted folders go through the system — we don't manage them. Restore later from Trash in Finder.
trash.deleteForeverConfirmBody: This can't be undone — the file skips the 30-day trash window and is removed from disk immediately.
trash.deleteConfirmBodyLibrary: The file goes to the trash and stays there for 30 days — you can restore it during that time.
trash.emptyHint: Deleted files stay here for 30 days.
